title: Verification
description: One verifier's verdicts on every merged finding of one batch, written independently of the other verifiers and without knowledge of labels (protocol.md section 5, verify protocol). Semantic check in panel.py: no_trigger_reason is non-null when the merged finding's trigger or wrong_output is null.

verdict.description: confirm: the failure scenario was reproduced or traced and no reason the code is correct was found. refute: a documented regime, caller precondition, convention or derivation shows the code is correct, or the trigger cannot occur. uncertain: correctness turns on an assumption the code and its documentation do not settle (named in deciding_assumption), or the scenario could not be established.

evidence.description: How the verdict was established. reproduced: the trigger was run (python3 -B or node) and its output observed. traced: the trigger was followed line by line through the code, with the lines named in reason. none: neither. A confirm with evidence none counts as uncertain.

refutation_search.description: Where the verifier looked for a reason the code is correct before deciding: the files, callers, docstrings and conventions read, and what each showed.
